            Prioritizing you
      
                          

            Mission for the Mind
      
                
            
As part of our ongoing commitment to employee well-being, the Mission for the Mind initiative at Leidos supports mental health through increased access to resources and strategic partnerships. This includes addressing critical challenges like substance use disorder, anxiety, depression, suicide prevention, and reducing the stigma surrounding mental health.
      
        
  Learn more on Prism

          
    

              
              

      
          
  
  

  
  

      
    

                        

            Supporting You and Your Family
      
                          

            Employee Benefits
      
                
            
As an eligible Leidos employee, you have the flexibility to choose from a wide variety of benefits that offer you and your family important health and financial protection. Benefits elections are made by employees at the time of hire, or as they become eligible, and during the annual Open Enrollment period.
      
        
  Learn more about your benefit options

          
    

              
              

      
          
  
  

  
  

      

    

                                  

Elevate your career from within
Ready to grow your career? Explore internal job openings across Leidos and find your next opportunity to advance, learn, and make an even greater impact.
Explore internal opportunities
            
          
  
  

  
  

      
    

                        

            Building a Better Workplace
      
                          

            Leidos Life
      
                
            
At Leidos, we have a strong focus on our employees’ career, flexibility, and well-being. We call this Leidos Life. It’s about embracing what makes Leidos great and renewing our commitment to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and engaged. Leidos Life supports a culture that helps you achieve personal and professional success while contributing to our mission.
      
        
  Learn more about Leidos Life on Prism

          
    

              
              

      
          
  
  

  
  

          
  

      

  

    

              
  

      

    
                                  

Need help?
If you are an employee and your request is urgent, please call the CIO Service Desk for your region. 
 United States
Call: 855-9-LEIDOS (534 367)  
Submit Ticket: Submit non-emergency tickets through CIO Central.  
Hours of Operation: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. Eastern Standard Time. 
            
          
  
  

              
  

      

    
                                  
United Kingdom & EMEAI
Hours of Operation: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. GMT (Excludes bank holidays) Australia & APAC
Call: +61 (1) 800 LEIDOS (534 367)  
Hours of Operation: Monday-Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Standard Time (Excluding national public holidays) 
Note: Calls outside operating hours are answered by the US Service Desk and escalated to the Australian team if necessary.
